description: This is an abstract base class for upgrade testing in an Orleans distributed system. It manages silo deployment, versioning, and testing scenarios involving multiple silo versions and grain activations.

classes.name: UpgradeTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing infrastructure for upgrade testing in Orleans, including silo management, version control, and test scenarios.

methods.name: GetVersionTestDirectory
methods.description: Locates the directory containing the test binary for a specific grain version.

methods.name: Step1_StartV1Silo_Step2_StartV2Silo_Step3_StopV2Silo
methods.description: Executes a test sequence involving starting a V1 silo, then a V2 silo, and then stopping the V2 silo, verifying grain versions at each step.

methods.name: ProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests proxy calls between grains with no pending requests, verifying version consistency.

methods.name: ProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests proxy calls with pending requests during silo upgrades, verifying version consistency.

methods.name: StartSiloV1
methods.description: Starts a silo with the V1 grain assembly.

methods.name: StartSiloV2
methods.description: Starts a silo with the V2 grain assembly.

methods.name: StartSilo
methods.description: Internal method to initialize and start a silo with specified grain assembly.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all deployed silos and cleans up resources.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of all silos and stops the cluster client.
